_readme: Authoring eval cases (see scripts/authoring_eval.py). Each case: a coaching brief in the shape the workout-author agent demands (PURPOSE, SESSION, RESTRICTIONS, CAPACITY, ATHLETE FACTS), the checks its rendering must satisfy (regexes over the preview step tree, case-insensitive; a steps_match entry may be {pattern, min}), and a golden session that satisfies them. The athlete is synthetic (evals/authoring/athlete.json): FTP 260 W, threshold pace 5:00/km, HR zones Z2 125-140, baseline goblet squat 20 kg and Bulgarian split squat 10 kg.

cases.brief:
PURPOSE: aerobic base; keep the week's easy day easy after yesterday's intervals.
SESSION: easy run, 45 minutes total: a 5-minute walk warm-up with no target on the watch, then 40 minutes continuous easy running at HR 125-140 bpm. No cool-down step. Name it 'Easy run 45'.
RESTRICTIONS: none (no active or improving injuries).
CAPACITY (demonstrated, last 28 days): running 6 sessions, longest 50 min / 9 km, typical 35-45 min easy; cycling 8 rides, longest 120 min; strength 2 a week; mobility 2 a week.
ATHLETE FACTS: FTP 260 W; threshold pace 5:00/km; max HR 185; HR zones Z1 under 125, Z2 125-140, Z3 140-155, Z4 155-168, Z5 168-185 bpm; strength baseline: goblet squat 20 kg, Bulgarian split squat 10 kg.

golden.name: Easy run 45
golden.purpose: Aerobic base; keep the easy day easy after intervals

cases.brief:
PURPOSE: threshold development, second quality session of the build block.
SESSION: 10-minute easy warm-up, then 6 x 3 minutes at 4:25-4:35 per km with 90-second easy jog recoveries, then a 5-minute easy cool-down. Name it 'Threshold 6x3'.
RESTRICTIONS: none (no active or improving injuries).
CAPACITY (demonstrated, last 28 days): running 6 sessions, longest 50 min / 9 km, typical 35-45 min easy, one interval session a week of 40-45 min; cycling 8 rides.
ATHLETE FACTS: FTP 260 W; threshold pace 5:00/km (300 s/km); max HR 185; HR zones Z2 125-140, Z4 155-168 bpm; strength baseline: goblet squat 20 kg.

golden.name: Threshold 6x3
golden.description: 6 x 3 min at threshold pace, 90 s jog recoveries
golden.purpose: Threshold development, second quality session of the build block

cases.brief:
PURPOSE: return-to-run ladder, level 3 of the physio's progression; load the tendon without a continuous run.
SESSION: 4 x (8 minutes run at HR 120-145 bpm, then 2 minutes walk with no target). Nothing before or after the repeats: no warm-up step, no cool-down step. Name it 'Run/walk 4x8'.
RESTRICTIONS: none (the running restriction was lifted last week; no active or improving injuries).
CAPACITY (demonstrated, last 28 days): running 5 run/walk sessions, longest 36 min total, last level 3 x 8/2 completed with HR under 145; cycling 8 rides.
ATHLETE FACTS: FTP 260 W; threshold pace 5:00/km; max HR 185; HR zones Z1 under 125, Z2 125-140, Z3 140-155 bpm; strength baseline: goblet squat 20 kg.

golden.name: Run/walk 4x8
golden.purpose: Return-to-run ladder, level 3 of the physio progression

RESTRICTIONS: none (no active or improving injuries).
CAPACITY (demonstrated, last 28 days): running 6 sessions, longest 14 km / 80 min, typical 35-45 min; cycling 8 rides.
ATHLETE FACTS: FTP 260 W; threshold pace 5:00/km; max HR 185; HR zones Z2 125-140 bpm; strength baseline: goblet squat 20 kg.

golden.name: Long run 16 km
golden.purpose: Long run, time on feet, the week's only long effort

RESTRICTIONS: none (no active or improving injuries).
CAPACITY (demonstrated, last 28 days): cycling 8 rides, longest 120 min, typical 60-75 min, one interval ride a week; running 6 sessions.
ATHLETE FACTS: FTP 260 W; power zones Z2 143-195 W, Z3 195-234 W, Z4 234-273 W, Z5 273-312 W; threshold pace 5:00/km; max HR 185; strength baseline: goblet squat 20 kg.

golden.name: Threshold 4x4
golden.description: 4 x 4 min at threshold on the trainer
golden.purpose: Threshold power, first hard ride of the block

cases.brief:
PURPOSE: sweet-spot work to lift FTP without the fatigue of full threshold; indoor.
SESSION: indoor trainer (type indoor_cycling). 10-minute warm-up at 120-150 W, then 2 x 20 minutes at 229-242 W (88-93 percent of FTP 260) with 5 minutes recovery at 120-140 W between, then a 5-minute cool-down at 100-120 W. Name it 'Sweet spot 2x20'.
RESTRICTIONS: none (no active or improving injuries).
CAPACITY (demonstrated, last 28 days): cycling 8 rides, longest 120 min, typical 60-75 min, last sweet-spot ride 2 x 15 completed; running 6 sessions.
ATHLETE FACTS: FTP 260 W; power zones Z2 143-195 W, Z3 195-234 W, Z4 234-273 W; threshold pace 5:00/km; max HR 185; strength baseline: goblet squat 20 kg.

golden.name: Sweet spot 2x20
golden.description: 2 x 20 min sweet spot on the trainer
golden.purpose: Sweet-spot work to lift FTP without full-threshold fatigue

cases.brief:
PURPOSE: re-anchor the power zones before the build block.
SESSION: 20-minute FTP test on the indoor trainer using the server's built-in protocol (session type ftp_test, no custom structure). Name it 'FTP test'.
RESTRICTIONS: none (no active or improving injuries).
CAPACITY (demonstrated, last 28 days): cycling 8 rides, longest 120 min, typical 60-75 min, one hard ride a week; running 6 sessions.
ATHLETE FACTS: FTP 260 W (last tested 8 weeks ago); max HR 185; threshold pace 5:00/km; strength baseline: goblet squat 20 kg.

golden.name: FTP test
golden.purpose: Re-anchor the power zones before the build block

cases.brief:
PURPOSE: lower-body strength per the physio's program, session 1 of 2 this week.
SESSION: 5-minute warm-up block first. Then: Bulgarian split squat 3 x 8 each side at 10 kg, cue 'Knee over toe, slow down'; single-leg Romanian deadlift 3 x 10 each side at 8 kg, cue 'Hips square'; seated calf raise 3 x 15 at 20 kg, cue 'Full range'. Timed 60-second rests between sets. Name it 'Lower body physio'.
RESTRICTIONS: none (no active or improving injuries).
CAPACITY (demonstrated, last 28 days): strength 2 gym sessions a week of 40-45 min, last lower session completed at these loads; running 6 sessions; cycling 8 rides.
ATHLETE FACTS: strength baseline (get_strength_baseline): goblet squat 20 kg, Bulgarian split squat 10 kg; FTP 260 W; threshold pace 5:00/km; max HR 185.

steps_match: BULGARIAN_SPLIT_SQUAT 8 reps @ 10 kg .*each side: knee over toe
ROMANIAN_DEADLIFT.* 10 reps @ 8 kg .*each side: hips square

golden.name: Lower body physio
golden.purpose: Lower-body strength per the physio program, session 1 of 2

cases.brief:
PURPOSE: trunk stability after the long ride; holds, not reps, per the physio.
SESSION: plank 3 x 45-second holds; side plank 3 x 30 seconds each side; dead bug 3 x 10 reps, cue 'Low back flat'. Lap-button rests (no timed rests). No warm-up block (done on the bike). Name it 'Core holds'.
RESTRICTIONS: none (no active or improving injuries).
CAPACITY (demonstrated, last 28 days): strength 2 gym sessions a week; the last core session held 40-second planks; cycling 8 rides; running 6 sessions.
ATHLETE FACTS: strength baseline (get_strength_baseline): goblet squat 20 kg, Bulgarian split squat 10 kg; FTP 260 W; threshold pace 5:00/km; max HR 185.

golden.name: Core holds
golden.description: Trunk stability: planks and dead bugs
golden.purpose: Trunk stability after the long ride; holds per the physio

cases.brief:
PURPOSE: full-body strength endurance in a short slot; circuit format to keep the heart rate up.
SESSION: 5-minute warm-up block, then a circuit of 3 rounds: goblet squat 10 reps at 20 kg, push-up 12 reps, inverted row 10 reps; 90 seconds rest after each round and no rest between the movements. Name it 'Circuit 3 rounds'.
RESTRICTIONS: none (no active or improving injuries).
CAPACITY (demonstrated, last 28 days): strength 2 gym sessions a week of 40-45 min, last circuit 3 rounds completed; running 6 sessions; cycling 8 rides.
ATHLETE FACTS: strength baseline (get_strength_baseline): goblet squat 20 kg, Bulgarian split squat 10 kg; FTP 260 W; threshold pace 5:00/km; max HR 185.

golden.name: Circuit 3 rounds
golden.purpose: Full-body strength endurance in a short slot

cases.brief:
PURPOSE: pulling strength; sets to technical failure because the rep count is unknown at this stage.
SESSION: pull-ups 3 sets to technical failure, each set ended with the lap button (open reps), 2-minute timed rests; then hanging knee raise 3 x 10 with lap-button rests. No warm-up block (done on the bike). Name it 'Pull-up strength'.
RESTRICTIONS: none (no active or improving injuries).
CAPACITY (demonstrated, last 28 days): strength 2 gym sessions a week; last pull-up session 3 sets of 5-7; running 6 sessions; cycling 8 rides.
ATHLETE FACTS: strength baseline (get_strength_baseline): goblet squat 20 kg, Bulgarian split squat 10 kg; FTP 260 W; threshold pace 5:00/km; max HR 185.

golden.name: Pull-up strength
golden.description: Pull-ups to technical failure, knee raises
golden.purpose: Pulling strength; sets to technical failure

cases.brief:
PURPOSE: pre-court activation before padel, inside the ankle restrictions.
SESSION: strength type. Side lunge to balance 2 x 8 each side with NO jump, cue 'No jump. Push off through the toe'; single-leg balance 3 x 30 seconds each side on the floor, cue 'Toe down'. Lap-button rests, no warm-up block. Name it 'Pre-court activation'.
RESTRICTIONS: active injury 'left ankle sprain' (status improving) with restricted_activities: ['jumping', 'plyometrics', 'running'] - verbatim. Never pick a Garmin exercise key that names a jump; use an off-catalogue readable name with its category instead.
CAPACITY (demonstrated, last 28 days): strength 2 sessions a week; this activation set done 4 times without ankle pain; cycling 8 rides; running 0 (restricted).
ATHLETE FACTS: strength baseline (get_strength_baseline): goblet squat 20 kg, Bulgarian split squat 10 kg; FTP 260 W; threshold pace 5:00/km; max HR 185.

golden.name: Pre-court activation
golden.description: Pre-padel activation inside the ankle restrictions
golden.purpose: Pre-court activation before padel, inside the ankle restrictions

exercises.name: Side lunge to balance
exercises.notes: No jump. Push off through the toe

cases.brief:
PURPOSE: lower-body strength maintenance.
SESSION: 5-minute warm-up block; goblet squat 3 x 10 - the load has NOT been decided and is not given here, do not assume one; push-up 3 x 12; lap-button rests. Name it 'Lower maintenance'.
RESTRICTIONS: none (no active or improving injuries).
CAPACITY (demonstrated, last 28 days): strength 2 gym sessions a week of 40-45 min.
ATHLETE FACTS: strength baseline: not provided; FTP 260 W; threshold pace 5:00/km; max HR 185.

PURPOSE: hip flexor length for the bike position; sleep-friendly evening downshift.
SESSION: 30-minute evening yoga flow at recovery intensity: couch stretch 2 min per side, 90/90 x 10, pigeon 2 min per side, box breathing 5 min. One timed block with the flow in the notes. Name it 'Hip mobility 30'.
RESTRICTIONS: none (no active or improving injuries).
CAPACITY (demonstrated, last 28 days): mobility 20-30 min twice a week, evening sessions followed by better sleep scores; cycling 8 rides; running 6 sessions.
ATHLETE FACTS: FTP 260 W; threshold pace 5:00/km; max HR 185; strength baseline: goblet squat 20 kg.

golden.name: Hip mobility 30
golden.purpose: Hip flexor length for the bike position; sleep-friendly downshift
golden.notes: Couch stretch 2 min/side, 90/90 x 10, pigeon 2 min/side, box breathing 5 min

cases.brief:
PURPOSE: peroneal strength and single-leg balance, physio set 3 of the week.
SESSION: ankle rehab tracked as Pilates (session type rehab): banded ankle eversion 2 x 20 each side, cue 'Slow'; single-leg balance on the BOSU 3 x 30-second holds, cue 'Toe down, not on the rim'; heel raises off a step 2 x 15. Lap-button rests. Name it 'Ankle rehab'.
RESTRICTIONS: active injury 'left ankle sprain' (status improving) with restricted_activities: ['jumping', 'plyometrics', 'running'] - verbatim.
CAPACITY (demonstrated, last 28 days): mobility and rehab sets 15 min, 3 times a week, all completed; cycling 8 rides; running 0 (restricted).
ATHLETE FACTS: FTP 260 W; threshold pace 5:00/km; max HR 185; strength baseline: goblet squat 20 kg.

golden.name: Ankle rehab
golden.description: Physio ankle set tracked as Pilates
golden.purpose: Peroneal strength and single-leg balance, physio set 3 of the week
